name: Juno 106
description: Ultramaster KR-106's engine (Karl LaRocca, GPL-3): the Juno-60 and Juno-106 from hardware measurements, firmware and schematics — the band-limited DCO, the IR3109 filter, the MN3009 bucket-brigade chorus, the 106's envelopes, component variance. Six voices; the 256 factory patches of both.
blurb: The Juno-106 (and the 60) as measured: DCO, IR3109 filter, BBD chorus I / II, the real envelopes. Range, Assign (unison or poly), the 256 factory patches.
